title: Return a Value
brief:
Functions can hand a value back to whoever called them, using return:

def steps_to(target):
    return target - position_x()

That does not move anyone — it works out a number and gives it back, so steps_to(12) can be used anywhere a number can, including as the argument to another function.

The flag is in column 12. Use steps_to to tell go_right how far to walk, without counting it yourself.
